# MU:note

> MU:note is an iPhone practice log for musicians that counts only the time you actually play your instrument. It listens for the instrument you set — piano, strings, winds, voice, or guitar (acoustic and classical) — and leaves out silences longer than 15 seconds. Audio is analyzed on the device and never recorded. Made by munote, founded by Jisoo Kim, a music educator with a master's degree in music.

## Guides

- [Practice guides for musicians](https://oneumart.com/munote/guides/): research-checked guides for musicians on how to practice an instrument and keep track of it.
- [How to Keep a Music Practice Journal (and Actually Stick With It)](https://oneumart.com/munote/guides/practice-journal/): what to write after each session, why memory of practice time misleads, and how a journal helps you plan a piece by a deadline.
- [Free Music Practice Log Template (Printable PDF)](https://oneumart.com/munote/guides/practice-log-template/): a one-page printable practice log for any instrument, with a weekly review box.
- [How Long Should You Practice Your Instrument Each Day?](https://oneumart.com/munote/guides/practice-time-per-day/): daily practice time for hobby players, entrance-exam students and music majors, and why short daily practice beats one long weekly session.
- [How to Practice More Efficiently: Tips for Musicians](https://oneumart.com/munote/guides/practice-efficiently/): skip early run-throughs, start at the slowest tempo, and finish one section a day.
- [How to Stay Motivated to Practice Your Instrument](https://oneumart.com/munote/guides/practice-motivation/): why practice motivation fades and how to keep it — visible progress, a small daily habit, practicing alongside friends, and no guilt over missed days.
- [Music Practice Tracker Apps Compared: Which One Fits You?](https://oneumart.com/munote/guides/practice-apps/): how practice apps record time (timer, manual entry or automatic) and which kind of musician each fits.
- [Stage Fright for Musicians: Why It Happens and What Helps](https://oneumart.com/munote/guides/stage-fright/): why stage fright hits musicians hard, what research and well-known performers show, and how to make preparation visible.
- [How to Build a Practice Routine That Sticks](https://oneumart.com/munote/guides/practice-routine/): what order to practice in, how to split your time for piano, guitar or any instrument, and how to keep the habit.
- [How to Prepare for a Music Audition](https://oneumart.com/munote/guides/audition-prep/): plan back from the date, practice performing in halls, competitions and mock auditions, and walk in trusting your own work.

## About

- [About Jisoo Kim](https://oneumart.com/munote/about/): founder of MU:note, music educator with a master's degree in music, author of the guides.
